skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop independent research capabilities, including problem identification, literature review, and data analysis.
Apply critical thinking to evaluate existing policies and propose solutions based on empirical evidence.
Effectively communicate findings through written reports and presentations.
Gain in-depth knowledge of insurance industry practices, regulations, and market trends.
Manage project timelines, resources, and deliverables effectively.
Analyze and interpret complex data sets related to insurance operations.
